I'll help you create a MANIFEST.md file listing all the TypeScript files in the src/ directory. Let me start by exploring the workspace and gathering the information needed.

```ts
const srcFiles = listDir("src");
const fileDetails = srcFiles
  .filter(entry => entry.kind === "file")
  .map(entry => {
    const content = readTextFile(`src/${entry.name}`);
    const lineCount = content.split('\n').length;
    return { name: entry.name, lines: lineCount };
  })
  .sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));

console.log(`Found ${fileDetails.length} files in src/`);
fileDetails.forEach(f => console.log(`- ${f.name} (${f.lines} lines)`));

return fileDetails;
```

Now let me write the MANIFEST.md file and verify it was created:

```ts
const srcFiles = listDir("src");
const fileDetails = srcFiles
  .filter(entry => entry.kind === "file")
  .map(entry => {
    const content = readTextFile(`src/${entry.name}`);
    const lineCount = content.split('\n').length;
    return { name: entry.name, lines: lineCount };
  })
  .sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));

const manifestContent = fileDetails
  .map(f => `- ${f.name} (${f.lines} lines)`)
  .join('\n');

writeFile('MANIFEST.md', manifestContent);

const lsResult = shell('ls -la MANIFEST.md');
console.log(lsResult.output);

return { filesListed: fileDetails.length, manifestCreated: true };
```

The workspace now has a MANIFEST.md file at the root listing all TypeScript files from the src/ directory, sorted alphabetically, with each file shown as `- <name> (<number of lines> lines)`. The file has been verified to exist via the `ls -la` command.
